scope: Three selected primary studies; qualitative perturbation comparison, not a systematic review or digitized effect-size benchmark.

studies.title: Microsurgical lesion of horizontal cells changes optomotor yaw responses in the blowfly Calliphora erythrocephala
studies.journal: Proceedings of the Royal Society B 219, 211-216
studies.evidence: Microsurgical interruption of HS axons changed visually evoked yaw torque in tethered blowflies, supporting a causal contribution to optomotor control.
studies.access_limit: Primary abstract and indexed text available; publisher full PDF unavailable. No experimental curve was digitized, and effect magnitude or detailed left/right waveform agreement is not claimed.
studies.model_comparison: Silence HSN, HSE and HSS in the left or right MaleCNS hemisphere, then compare frozen steering-decoder outputs under rightward, leftward and forward motion drive. Bilateral loss is an added control.
studies.mismatch: Fruit-fly model versus blowfly study; cell silencing versus microsurgical lesion; neural decoder versus torque. Graded HS signals and electrical coupling are absent.

studies.title: Object tracking in motion-blind flies
studies.evidence: Blocking T4/T5 output abolished the optomotor response while reduced black-bar fixation remained in walking Drosophila.
studies.model_comparison: Silence all 13,580 T4/T5 cells and test rightward, leftward and forward drive. The separately driven looming trial is an additional input-bypass control.
studies.mismatch: Walking versus wing-motor readout. T4/T5 are directly driven model inputs, making response abolition a structurally simple sanity check. Black-bar fixation and upstream looming computation are not simulated.

studies.title: Neural Basis for Looming Size and Velocity Encoding in the Drosophila Giant Fiber Escape Pathway
studies.evidence: LPLC2 silencing removed the size-dependent component of the giant-fiber looming response, leaving the LC4-associated velocity component. LPLC2 was necessary for GF-mediated escape.
studies.model_comparison: Silence 185 LPLC2 neurons during the existing combined LC4/LPLC2 drive; measure mean giant-fiber firing. LC4-only and double blockade are additional controls.
studies.mismatch: Constant Poisson drive has no angular-size or velocity dynamics. GF spike rate is not the experimental graded voltage endpoint. Escape probability and takeoff timing are not represented.

hs_specificity_context.title: Quantitative Predictions Orchestrate Visual Signaling in Drosophila
hs_specificity_context.relevance: More selective HS/VS hyperpolarization in Drosophila strongly weakened head optomotor responses but had more modest effects on wing steering. The authors note that older lesion methods could affect additional cells. This limits a direct interpretation of selective HS loss as reproducing the old microsurgery assay.

interpretive_context.title: Bilateral interactions of optic-flow sensitive neurons coordinate course control in flies
interpretive_context.relevance: Electrical interactions in the HS-H2 circuit contribute to course-control behavior. This strengthens the caution about interpreting a chemical-synapse-only HS simulation as a full physiological reproduction.
